SakrasyAhaM sutA brahman pitrA tuByaM samarpitA
SaNkaraM purataH kftvA vizRuM ca balinAM varam
SaWe duzwasamAcAre kiM na jAnAsi pAtakam
SaptA yUyaM mayA pUrvaM kroDayuktena putrakAH
SabdAdInAM ca paYcAnAM maDye sparSasuKaM varam
SaMsa me kAraRaM mAtaH karomi vigatajvarAm
SaraRA dAnavAH sarve jahi vA rakza vA punaH
SaSAde svargate rAjA kakutsTa iti cABavat
SaSApa ca nfpaM kroDAdvaYcitastu punaH punaH
SApaM tava pradAsyAmi na cedadya prayacCasi
SivaSizyA ca sA devI tena SEvI prakIrtitA
Sive kiM vA jYAtvA vividizasi SaktiM maDujitaH
SudDaM smArtaM cAcamanaM pOrARaM vEdikaM taTA
SfRu kAnte pravakzyAmi yaM DyAyAmi surottamam
SfRu tAta pravakzyAmi yanme manasi vAYCitam
SfRu rAjan purA vfttaM satIdAyasya kAraRam
SfRu SOre vaco mahyaM saguRAhaM caturBujA
SfRvantu nirjarAH sarve vyAharantyA vaco mama
SokaM mA kuru deveSa SApo'yaM te purAtanaH
SradDAtra triviDA proktA sAttvikI rAjasI taTA
SrAnte BIte tyaktaSastre patite bAlake taTA
SrutaM te'dya biqAlAKya BavAnyA kaTitaM ca yat
SrutaM sarvaM suraSrezWa mA rodIrvacanaM SfRu
SrutvA tezAM vaco rAjA noktvA kiYcicCuBASuBam
SlokasyArDaM mayA pUrvaM SrutaM devi sPuwAkzaram
Sveta evASvarAjo'yaM kiM vA tvaM manyase SuBe
